data.one_liner: A widget that scrolls specific input controls out of the way when the keyboard appears.
data.what_it_does: The avoid_keyboard package includes an AvoidKeyboard widget to wrap text fields and input controls. It shifts contents only if the keyboard actually overlaps the focused input control, without compressing the entire viewport.
use_when: You want specific view regions to avoid the keyboard instead of compressing the entire view
You have fixed height columns where default Scaffold resizing fails
You need input controls to scroll into view when traversed via keyboard focus events
avoid_when: You prefer the default Scaffold resizing behavior for the entire viewport
strengths: Only shifts contents when the keyboard overlaps the focused input control
Allows avoiding keyboard for specific view regions rather than the whole screen
Responds to focus traversal events while the keyboard is up
weaknesses: Limited documentation regarding advanced configuration options
Depends on the specific layout structures supported by the widget
